translate_en|mods/HephasVitamines/common: Hephas Vitamins
Enable Vitamin Sayings
If enabled, your character will say immersive/funny lines when getting healed by the vitamins intake.
Vitamins Fatigue Change
Adjusts how much fatigue is reduced when taking vitamins.
Vitamins Healing Amount
Determines how much health you recover when the healing effect triggers. Higher values restore more health.
Vitamins Healing Chance
Sets the chance (in %) that taking vitamins will heal you. Higher values mean a greater chance for a health boost.
Vitamins Stress Change
Adjusts how much stress is added when taking vitamins. Default is 1 means taking a pill increases stress by 0.01.
Vitamins Delta Usage

Controls how many times each vitamin item can be used. For example, a value of 1 means the item is consumed in one use, 0.5 allows two uses, 0.25 allows four uses, and so on. Lower values increase reusability.
A bottle of vitamins. May help you recover some health and reduce fatigue.
